# tomswallapi_arp_rule (Resource)

An ARP-level rule on a device.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "tomswallapi_arp_rule" "drop_spoof" {
  device = "fw1"
  action = "DROP"
  source = "eth1:192.0.2.1"
  opcode = 2
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `action` (String) ARP action (ACCEPT, DROP, SNAT, or DNAT).
- `device` (String) Owning device.

### Optional

- `action_address` (String) Replacement IP address for SNAT/DNAT actions.
- `action_mac` (String) Replacement MAC address for SNAT/DNAT actions.
- `comment` (String) Free-form comment.
- `dest` (String) Destination interface, address, or MAC to match.
- `opcode` (Number) ARP opcode to match (1 = request, 2 = reply).
- `source` (String) Source interface, address, or MAC to match.

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) The ID of this resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by the server-assigned numeric id.
terraform import tomswallapi_arp_rule.drop_spoof 42
```
